acquisition_batches_check_2.name: acquisition_batches_check_2
acquisition_batches_check_2.value: acquired_on IS NULL OR (acquired_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(acquired_on, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(acquired_on, '+0 days') = acquired_on)

album_releases_check_2.name: album_releases_check_2
album_releases_check_2.value: (release_date IS NULL AND date_precision IS NULL) OR (release_date IS NOT NULL AND date_precision IS NOT NULL AND ((date_precision = 'year' AND release_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]') OR (date_precision = 'month' AND release_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]') OR (date_precision = 'day' AND release_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]')))

collection_items_check_4.name: collection_items_check_4
collection_items_check_4.value: acquired_on IS NULL OR (acquired_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(acquired_on, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(acquired_on, '+0 days') = acquired_on)

cover_assets_check_4.name: cover_assets_check_4
cover_assets_check_4.value: source_language IS NULL OR source_language IN ('EN','JP','KR')

cover_variants_check_2.name: cover_variants_check_2
cover_variants_check_2.value: (object_key IS NOT NULL) + (external_url IS NOT NULL) = 1

external_refs_check_2.name: external_refs_check_2
external_refs_check_2.value: (series_id IS NOT NULL) + (volume_edition_id IS NOT NULL) + (album_id IS NOT NULL) + (release_id IS NOT NULL) + (creator_id IS NOT NULL) = 1

metadata_cache_check_2.name: metadata_cache_check_2
metadata_cache_check_2.value: payload_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(payload_json) AND length(payload_json) <= 1048576)

volume_editions_confirmed_isbn_uq.name: volume_editions_confirmed_isbn_uq
volume_editions_confirmed_isbn_uq.where: isbn13 IS NOT NULL AND metadata_state = 'confirmed'

volume_editions_check_2.name: volume_editions_check_2
volume_editions_check_2.value: isbn13 IS NULL OR (length(isbn13) = 13 AND isbn13 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
